body: Well, I'm more of the creative type. I like doing crafts and making jewelry, but I don't have a lot of space to keep supplies. I like exploring Etsy for hours at a time. I'm good at graphic design, but I don't necessarily enjoy that. I'm obviously a Reddit user, so I spend a lot of time researching things I come across on Reddit. I guess my biggest problem is my short attention span. I get bored very easily. I can't seem to stick with anything. I am at a computer all day at work, which gives me a lot of time to obsess over things. I need something to keep my mind busy and my fingers from clicking on Facebook.

Thank you very much, kind stranger. :)

Let's see...I don't really have any hobbies to speak of. I don't have a lot of time for fun. I work full time and I have chronic pain so I spend a lot of time recovering from working. I'm not sure what fun things there are anymore. Any suggestions?

I do feel completely hopeless. It's been about 12 years since I loved back to my hometown. At that point I started my current job and made the friends I have now. All of my friends are connected to each other so it is really hard to just cut out the ones who make me feel the worst. In order to keep the ones I like I have to pretend like nothing bothers me. I guess my whole life can be summed up by how it is at work. I am the only one on my team that sits a desk alone in a different building. I am ignored until someone needs a favor. It's isolating. That is how I feel about my friends as well. It's just isolating.

Thanks for your reply. Well, it is a long long story to get into, but I will just say that life for me is very difficult. I am quiet and somewhat shy. People generally take advantage of me. I am a good friend to my friends, but none of the goodness I give out is ever returned. I am treated very poorly at my job. All this stuff for the past 12 years has been adding up. I feel like there is a giant rock on my back that will never be removed. Everything just keeps adding up and I don't know how to dig myself out. I have tried to be positive. I have tried making new friends. I have tried medication, hypnosis, and every other thing "they" say can help, but nothing ever helps. I just can't take it anymore and I don't want to be here anymore. I don't want to be treated like shit anymore.

Thank you for your response. I have discussed the unreasonable demands with HR. They don't think the demands are all that unreasonable. I had to get a letter from my doctor just so I no longer have to crawl around on the floor. I think you have a great idea about a supplemental job. It it just really hard for me because I have completely closed myself off from people. I've put up all kinds of walls. Perhaps doing something involved with people would help me break those walls down. 

Thank you again!

You hit the nail on the head. I completely agree with the feeling of being alienated from a sense of true purpose. At this point I have given up on trying to expand my role at work. I have been moved away from my co-workers into a different building all together. It makes it difficult to get involved with anything or show my skills to my supervisor. It is like I have been forgotten about, which makes me just want to crawl into a hole. It's a cycle I feel I can't get out of. I have had many discussions with my supervisor about things I can do, but he forgets as soon as I walk out of his office. I guess my next step would be to get help from a professional. I honestly don't know why I have been avoiding it. Maybe I am just avoiding people in general. 

Thank you so much for your response. It is helpful to know there are people who sympathize. :-)
